verdict.rationale: Bruno ships an official CLI that runs API collections from the command line. It is documented for CI/CD use in Docker, GitHub Actions and other pipelines, with official Docker images, and it emits JUnit, JSON and HTML test reports that CI systems can consume. Collections support assertions and test suites, so regressions surface as failing tests. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that failed assertions produce a non-zero exit code to fail the build, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
